# Yandex
> Yandex is a technology company offering search, cloud, maps, mail, advertising, and developer platforms.

This llms.txt highlights major developer, API, cloud, and product documentation across Yandex properties, prioritizing technical references and support resources.

## Developer Platform
- [Yandex Developer](https://yandex.com/dev/): Central hub for Yandex APIs, SDKs, and developer documentation.
- [Documentation](https://yandex.com/dev/docs/): Entry point for Yandex developer product documentation and references.
- [Support](https://yandex.com/dev/support/): Developer support resources for Yandex platform users.
- [OAuth](https://yandex.com/dev/id/): Documentation for Yandex ID and authorization-related integrations.

## Yandex Cloud
- [Yandex Cloud Documentation](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/): Main documentation for Yandex Cloud services and platform usage.
- [Getting Started](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/getting-started/): Introductory guides for creating and configuring cloud resources.
- [CLI](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/cli/): Reference and setup instructions for the Yandex Cloud command-line interface.
- [API Reference](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/api-design-guide/): API usage conventions and integration guidance for cloud services.
- [Terraform](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/tutorials/infrastructure-management/terraform-quickstart): Quickstart for managing Yandex Cloud infrastructure with Terraform.
- [IAM](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/iam/): Identity and access management concepts, roles, and authentication methods.

## Compute and Infrastructure
- [Compute Cloud](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/compute/): Documentation for virtual machines, disks, images, and instance management.
- [Virtual Private Cloud](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/vpc/): Networking documentation for subnets, routes, gateways, and security groups.
- [BareMetal](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/baremetal/): Documentation for dedicated bare metal infrastructure in Yandex Cloud.
- [Managed Service for Kubernetes](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/managed-kubernetes/): Guides and references for managed Kubernetes clusters.
- [Container Registry](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/container-registry/): Documentation for storing and managing container images.
- [Serverless Containers](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/serverless-containers/): Reference for deploying and operating serverless container workloads.

## Data and AI
- [Object Storage](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/storage/): Documentation for S3-compatible object storage and bucket operations.
- [Managed Service for PostgreSQL](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/managed-postgresql/): Service documentation for hosted PostgreSQL clusters and administration.
- [Managed Service for ClickHouse](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/managed-clickhouse/): Documentation for managed ClickHouse analytics clusters.
- [Data Proc](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/dataproc/): Managed Hadoop and Spark service documentation.
- [DataSphere](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/datasphere/): Documentation for machine learning development and collaborative notebooks.
- [SpeechKit](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/speechkit/): Speech recognition and synthesis APIs, concepts, and examples.
- [Translate](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/translate/): Machine translation service documentation and API usage.
- [Vision](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/vision/): Computer vision API documentation for OCR and image analysis.

## Maps and Geoservices
- [Yandex Maps API](https://yandex.com/dev/maps/): Developer hub for Yandex Maps APIs and geoservices.
- [JavaScript API](https://yandex.com/dev/maps/jsapi/): Documentation for embedding and customizing interactive maps on the web.
- [Static API](https://yandex.com/dev/maps/staticapi/): Reference for generating static map images via HTTP requests.
- [Geocoder API](https://yandex.com/dev/geocode/): API documentation for geocoding and reverse geocoding requests.
- [Routing API](https://yandex.com/dev/routing/): Documentation for route building and logistics-related geoservices.
- [MapKit](https://yandex.com/dev/mapkit/): SDK documentation for integrating Yandex maps into mobile applications.

## Identity and Authentication
- [Yandex ID](https://yandex.com/dev/id/): Overview of Yandex identity platform and integration options.
- [OAuth Documentation](https://yandex.com/dev/id/doc/en/): Authorization flows, scopes, and token handling for Yandex APIs.
- [Login Integration](https://yandex.com/dev/id/doc/en/concepts/about): Concepts for implementing Yandex sign-in and account access.
- [Web SDK](https://yandex.com/dev/id/doc/en/sdk/web/): Web integration guidance for Yandex ID authentication flows.

## Webmaster and Search
- [Yandex Webmaster](https://webmaster.yandex.com/): Tools for site indexing, diagnostics, and search performance monitoring.
- [Webmaster Help](https://yandex.com/support/webmaster/): Official help center for Yandex Webmaster tools and reports.
- [Indexing](https://yandex.com/support/webmaster/en/robot-workings/site-indexing): Guidance on how Yandex indexes websites and pages.
- [Sitemap Files](https://yandex.com/support/webmaster/en/indexing-options/sitemap): Instructions for sitemap submission and processing.
- [Turbo Pages](https://yandex.com/support/webmaster/en/turbo/): Documentation for creating and managing Turbo pages.

## Advertising APIs
- [Yandex Direct API](https://yandex.com/dev/direct/): API documentation for managing Yandex Direct advertising campaigns.
- [Direct API Reference](https://yandex.com/dev/direct/doc/en/): Methods, objects, and integration details for Direct API clients.
- [Yandex Metrica](https://yandex.com/support/metrica/): Analytics platform help and implementation documentation.
- [Metrica Tag](https://yandex.com/support/metrica/en/code/counter-initialize): Instructions for installing and configuring the Metrica tracking tag.
- [AppMetrica](https://appmetrica.yandex.com/docs/en/): Documentation for mobile app analytics and attribution.

## Mail and Communication APIs
- [Yandex Mail for Domain](https://yandex.com/support/mail360/): Documentation for hosted mail administration and domain setup.
- [Yandex 360 Admin](https://yandex.com/support/yandex-360/): Help resources for Yandex 360 collaboration and administration.
- [Tracker](https://yandex.ru/support/tracker/): Documentation for Yandex Tracker issue management workflows.
- [Telemost](https://yandex.com/support/telemost/): Help documentation for Yandex Telemost meetings and communication tools.

## Support and Help
- [Yandex Support](https://yandex.com/support/): Main support portal for Yandex products and services.
- [Yandex Browser Help](https://browser.yandex.com/help/): User documentation for Yandex Browser features and settings.
- [Yandex Mail Help](https://yandex.com/support/mail/): Help center for Yandex Mail usage and troubleshooting.
- [Yandex Disk Help](https://yandex.com/support/disk/): Documentation for cloud file storage and synchronization.
- [Yandex Maps Help](https://yandex.com/support/maps/): User help for Yandex Maps and related geoservices.
